topic: The $2,700 record pizza vs the $9,000 pizza
style: Photorealistic luxury food look, dark and rich with gold accents
requestedEnding: Asks the viewer whether they would pay it, then promises part two

storyArc.protagonist: A black squid-ink pizza with gold leaf
storyArc.goal: Show a $2,700 record pizza next to a $5 slice.
storyArc.obstacle: An Italian chef makes one costing about $9,000.
storyArc.turn: Lobster, three caviars, 72-hour dough, cognac and champagne.
storyArc.visualBible: Dark marble, warm candlelight, gold accents, photorealistic food photography, no people faces.

plan.title: Same Food, Two Prices: $5 vs $2,700
plan.hook: Same food, two prices: five dollars, or two thousand seven hundred.
plan.payoff: Would you pay nine thousand dollars for pizza? Follow for part two!
claimsToCheck: Guinness World Records: most expensive pizza commercially available, $2,700, Industry Kitchen, New York, 24 April 2017; black squid-ink dough, white Stilton, foie gras, truffles, Ossetra and Almas caviar, 24-karat gold leaf (guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/most-expensive-pizza)

Tasting Table: Louis XIII pizza by Renato Viola, Salerno, EUR 8,300 (about $9,250), three caviars, lobster, buffalo mozzarella, dough proofed 72 hours, served with Louis XIII cognac, Krug champagne (tastingtable.com/749277/this-is-the-most-expensive-pizza-in-the-world)
The $5 slice is an illustrative everyday price, not a sourced figure

shots.narration: Same food, two prices: five dollars, or two thousand seven hundred.
shots.imagePrompt: A round black squid-ink pizza covered in gold leaf with one slice lifted away on a stretch of white cheese, and a plain pepperoni slice on a white paper plate at lower left, cheese stretching as the slice lifts. Photorealistic high-end product photograph. A dark marble counter in a warm kitchen. Vertical 9:16 frame, camera 30 degrees above the counter, pizza centred, paper-plate slice at lower left. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, sharp focus on the pizza. Bright warm key light from the upper left with golden highlights. Glossy black crust, gold leaf, stretchy mozzarella. The slice and cheese strand have clear space around them, steam can rise, simple background.
shots.motionPrompt: The camera glides smoothly to the right along the counter, revealing the black gold pizza as the cheese strand stretches and steam rises; the pepperoni slice stays in the lower left.
shots.sound: Soft sizzle, a gentle whoosh as the camera glides, and a gold shimmer

shots.narration: A Guinness World Record: squid-ink dough, Stilton cheese, and twenty-four karat gold.
shots.imagePrompt: A close-up of black pizza dough with white Stilton crumbles and flakes of 24-karat gold leaf, gold flakes settling on the cheese. Photorealistic high-end product photograph. A dark marble counter. Vertical 9:16 frame, the object centred with generous negative space above and below. Shot on an 85mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the object. Three-point softbox lighting with a warm key light and a specular highlight on the gold surfaces. Polished 24K gold (#D4AF37), black velvet, clear glass, fine reflections. The object sits fully visible with crisp reflections, a slow camera push-in has room to travel, the backdrop stays dark and uncluttered.
shots.motionPrompt: Slow glide across the pizza surface as a flake of gold leaf drifts down and settles on the cheese.

shots.narration: One Italian chef beats it. His pizza costs about nine thousand dollars.
shots.imagePrompt: Two hands stretching proofed pizza dough on a floured wooden board, the dough gently stretching wider. Photorealistic editorial food photograph. A warm Italian kitchen with copper pots behind. Vertical 9:16 frame, the dish centred in the lower middle with soft negative space above. Shot on a 50mm lens at a 35 degree angle, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on the dish. Soft window light from the left with gentle warm highlights and a faint rim light. Glistening sauce, crisp edges, steam, matte ceramic plate, dark wood table. The dish and hands are fully in frame with clean edges, steam and a utensil have room to move, the background stays simple.
